gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: shouldn't have + participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: Someone should test this water regularly.
gaps.explanation: should test → should be tested (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: 'Have you finished the report?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with if/whether + statement word order.

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.
